_comment: 英文侧人工覆盖：notes = 我们自己的规则注解（非原书文字）；textFixes = TextOnly 导出残留的修补记录（可审计）

notes.10.2: Artifact rule: mark this object as an Artifact in the Resource panel. From now on, whenever you lose a Resource through an encounter with an immortal, this item must be lost first; if you still hold it when an ending is reached, you may rewrite that ending.
notes.22.2: If you have a diary: when the diary is lost, strike out every Memory it holds. If you have no diary, lose a Resource instead.
notes.44.1: Branch: if you hold a Memory about this immortal, lose two Resources; otherwise lose three Resources and check a Skill.
notes.51.3: This mortal Character never dies of old age (they still count as a mortal Character).
notes.65.1: The trade brings in two contemporary Resources: strike out your oldest Resource and create two new ones.

61.2.why: TextOnly 导出把表单占位符 [a][b] 一并写进了正文；原书印的是填空式印记名
